scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Greetings, adventurer.
I am Gatei Knumm, keeper
of this Thanatos Tower.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
冒险者，您好。
我是加泰·克努姆，这座达纳托斯塔的守塔人。
请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation: 达纳托斯塔？

scripts.text: Entrance Fee?
scripts.translation: 入场费？

scripts.text: Enter the tower
scripts.translation: 进入塔内

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Yes, the tower in front
of you was an ancient ruins
that got its name from a word
written on a stone plate found
inside. Today, this place is
a popular tourist attraction.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
是的，您面前的这座塔原本是古代遗迹，
其名称来源于在塔内发现的一块石板上的文字。
如今，这里已成为一处热门的旅游景点。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
This tower grew in popularity
for adventurers when the
Rekenber Corporation began
tower reconstruction efforts.
The 1st and 2nd floors are now
repaired and free of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
当雷肯贝尔公司开始进行塔体修复工程后，
这座塔在冒险者中逐渐变得流行起来。
目前，1楼和2楼已经修复完毕，且没有魔物出没。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
However, reconstruction of
the 3rd and higher floors is
incomplete. Those levels are
still infested with monsters, so we're contracting temp workers
to exterminate all of them.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
不过，3楼及更高层的修复工作尚未完成。
那些楼层仍然有魔物出没，因此我们正招募临时工
来清除所有的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
If you're interested in
temporary contract work,
or would like to know about
this place in detail, please
ask one of the guides inside.
Thank you and enjoy your visit~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
如果您对临时契约工作感兴趣，
或者想详细了解这个地方，
请咨询塔内的向导。
谢谢，祝您参观愉快~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Everyone is welcome to
enjoy Thanatos Tower.
Only the 1st and 2nd floors
are open to the public at
this time. The entrance fee
is 5,000 zeny per person.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
欢迎所有人来达纳托斯塔游玩。
目前仅1楼和2楼对公众开放。
入场费为每人5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
5,000 zeny may seem a little
steep for a tourist attraction,
but trust me, this tower provides a very unique experience. Also,
our loyal customers and contract workers get a special discount~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
5,000 Zeny作为旅游景点的门票可能略显昂贵，
但请相信我，这座塔能带来非常独特的体验。
此外，
我们的忠实顾客和契约工人可以享受特别折扣~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Would you like to
enter Thanatos Tower?
The entry fee is ^FF00005,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
您想要进入达纳托斯塔吗？
入场费为^FF00005,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Oh, {0}!
Welcome back! Since you've
got a temporary Rekenber
work contract, your entrance
fee is only 3,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
哦，{0}！
欢迎回来！既然您持有雷肯贝尔的临时工作契约，
您的入场费只需3,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Thank you, and
please keep up the
good work. Ah, and don't
forget: safety first when
you fight those monsters!
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
谢谢，
请继续努力工作。啊，还有别忘了：
与魔物战斗时，安全第一！

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Oh, I'm sorry...
But you don't seem to
have enough zeny. Oh well,
just come back again later~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
哦，抱歉...
看来您的Zeny不足。好吧，
请稍后再来~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
You must be busy, then.
Well, not to worry, we'll
always be here. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
您一定很忙吧。
嗯，别担心，我们会一直在这里。再见~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Ah, I've received your
entrance fee. Thank you
very much. Now, I hope
you enjoy your visit
to Thanatos Tower~
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
啊，我已收到您的入场费。
非常感谢。现在，
希望您能在达纳托斯塔度过愉快的时光~

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Well...
Hm. I'm sorry, but you
don't seem to have enough
zeny for the entrance fee.
Please come back later...
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
嗯...
唔。抱歉，看来您的Zeny不足以支付入场费。
请稍后再来...

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Very well. Please come
and visit us again here
in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
好的。欢迎再次光临达纳托斯塔。

scripts.text:
[Gatei]
Hmm? Very well.
But if you wish to visit
this Thanatos Tower, please
do not hesitate to ask me.
Thank you and have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[加泰]
嗯？好的。
但如果您想参观这座达纳托斯塔，
请随时向我咨询。
谢谢，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Tower Keeper]
Excuse me, but you cannot
enter. This place is under
the Rekenber Corporation's
administration, and this area
is restricted to all those
without authorization.
scripts.translation:
[守塔人]
抱歉，您不能进入。
此地由雷肯贝尔公司管理，
该区域禁止所有未经授权人员进入。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Welcome to Thanatos Tower.
The tower's reconstruction is
a Rekenber Corporation project,
and the 1st and 2nd floors are
now open to the public. So
how may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
欢迎来到达纳托斯塔。
这座塔的改建工程是雷肯贝尔公司的项目，
目前1楼和2楼已向公众开放。
请问今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Tower Information
scripts.translation: 塔楼资讯

scripts.text: Temporary Work Contract
scripts.translation: 临时工作契约

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
When this tower was built,
who built it, and its purpose
are all mysteries. There are
many rumors about it being a
Mage lab, a hero's momunent,
or a demon fortress...
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
这座塔是何时建造的、由谁建造、
以及它的用途，至今仍是谜团。
关于它的传说有很多，
有人说它是魔法师的实验室，
也有人说它是英雄的纪念碑，
甚至是恶魔的堡垒...

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
The Rekenber Corporation has
been researching the origin of
this tower, but has not yet been able to confirm anything. Although
we've lost many researchers to the tower monsters, we won't give up!
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
雷肯贝尔公司一直在研究这座塔的起源，
但至今尚未确认任何事实。虽然
我们有许多研究员丧命于塔内的魔物，
但我们不会放弃！

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Rekenber is convinced that this
tower holds many secrets, and
successfully reconstructed the
first 2 floors of this tower in
the pursuit of this knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
雷肯贝尔坚信这座塔隐藏着许多秘密，
为了追寻这些知识，
我们成功改建了这座塔的前两层。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Currently, we are focused on
reconstructing the tower's 3rd
and 4th floors. Luckily, many
adventurers are exterminating
the monsters on those floors, working under temporary contracts.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
目前，我们正专注于改建
这座塔的3楼和4楼。幸运的是，
许多冒险者正在那里清剿魔物，
他们与我们签订了临时工作契约。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
At this rate, we expect
to complete reconstruction
of the 3rd and 4th floors in
the near future, bringing us
closer to our goal of opening all 12 floors of Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
照这个进度，我们预计
在不久的将来完成3楼和4楼的改建，
这将让我们更接近
开放达纳托斯塔全部12层的目标。

scripts.text: Tower Monsters?
scripts.translation: 塔内的魔物？

scripts.text: Temp Contract Work?
scripts.translation: 临时工作契约？

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Yes, when we began
reconstruction of the
Thanatos Tower, these
monsters that look like angels
just appeared out of nowhere
to attack all the workers.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
是的，当我们开始
改建达纳托斯塔时，
这些看起来像天使的魔物
不知从哪里冒出来，
攻击了所有的工人。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
At first, witnesses thought
that these monsters might
be, you know, actual angels.
But if they were, why were they
attacking for no reason?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
起初，目击者以为
这些魔物可能是真正的天使。
但如果是天使，
为什么要无缘无故地攻击呢？

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Anyway, we asked the Juno 
Sage Academy to investigate
them, and they confirmed that
these angelic creatures are true monsters--their resemblance to
angels is merely coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
总之，我们请朱诺贤者学院
进行了调查，他们确认
这些天使般的生物确实是魔物——
它们长得像天使只是巧合。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
You may have already heard
from the Tower Keeper, but
we're contracting adventurers to exterminate the tower monsters
in the 3rd and higher levels on
a temporary employee basis.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
您可能已经从守塔人那里听说了，
我们正在招募冒险者，
以临时员工的身份
清剿3楼及以上楼层的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
I'm in charge of hiring
temp contract workers, so
talk to me if you're interested. Only temp workers are allowed
to access the higher levels
here in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
我负责招募临时契约工，
如果您有兴趣，请与我交谈。
只有临时工才允许
进入达纳托斯塔的高层。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
To develop the floors above
the 2nd floor, we're going to
need as many temp contract
workers as we can hire. Why
don't you consider working
for us under a temp contract?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
为了开发2楼以上的楼层，
我们需要尽可能多的临时契约工。
您何不考虑与我们签订
临时工作契约呢？

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
You may have already heard
from the Tower Keeper, but
we're contracting adventurers to exterminate the tower monsters
in the 3rd and higher levels on
a temporary employee basis.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
您可能已经从守塔人那里听说了，
我们正在招募冒险者，
以临时员工的身份
清剿3楼及以上楼层的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
I'm in charge of hiring
temp contract workers, so
talk to me if you're interested. Only temp workers are allowed
to access the higher levels
here in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
我负责招募临时契约工，
如果您有兴趣，请与我交谈。
只有临时工才允许
进入达纳托斯塔的高层。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Well, if you have any
questions, feel free to
ask me later. My name is
Ditze Lappa. Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
嗯，如果您有任何问题，
稍后可以随时问我。
我叫迪策·拉帕。祝您有美好的一天！

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
For more detailed information
about monster exterminations,
please ask the 2nd Floor Guide
and the Guide next to me. Well,
we hope you enjoy your experience working with Rekenber Corporation~
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
如需了解更多关于清剿魔物的详细信息，
请咨询2楼的向导
以及我旁边的向导。嗯，
希望您能与雷肯贝尔公司合作愉快~

scripts.text: Maybe next time
scripts.translation: 下次再说吧

scripts.text: Sure, I'd like to work for you.
scripts.translation: 好的，我想为你们工作。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Well, alright.
But come and talk to
me as soon as you decide
that you want to help with
the tower reconstruction by
working for Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
嗯，好的。
但请在我这里决定
是否愿意为雷肯贝尔工作，
协助塔楼改建时，
尽快来找我。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
That's great!
Would you please fill
out this employment
agreement first? Let's
see. Your name is...
{0}, right?
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
太好了！
请先填写这份
雇佣协议好吗？
让我看看。您的名字是...
{0}，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Alright, please read
this agreement carefully.
If you agree with all of
the conditions, go ahead
and just sign the bottom.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
好的，请仔细阅读
这份协议。
如果您同意所有条款，
请在底部签字即可。

scripts.text:
^3355FFDitze hands you the
Employment Agreement
document for you to read.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF迪策递给您
一份雇佣协议
供您阅读。^000000

scripts.text:

is effective between Rekenber

Sign
scripts.translation: 签字

scripts.text: Don't Sign
scripts.translation: 不签字

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou sign two copies of the
Employment Agreement.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您签署了
两份雇佣协议。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Thank you. Now, you are
an official employee of the
Rekenber Corporation! Well,
within the limits of this tower
anyway. This contract doesn't
apply outside of this place.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
谢谢。现在，您已经是
雷肯贝尔公司的正式员工了！
当然，是在这座塔的范围内。
这份合同在此地之外不适用。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
From now on, you can talk
to the 2nd Floor Guide to
enter the 3rd Floor. If you
have any mission reward
questions, please ask ^3355FFLiei^000000.
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
从现在开始，您可以与
2楼的向导交谈
以进入3楼。如果您有任何
任务奖励的问题，请咨询^3355FF莉埃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
If you want to check
more information about
your work, please talk
to the 2nd Floor Guide.
Thank you, and welcome
to the Rekenber Corporation~
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
如果您想查看
更多工作信息，请与
2楼的向导交谈。
谢谢，欢迎加入
雷肯贝尔公司~

scripts.text:
[Ditze]
Oh? Was there an article
within the contract that you
disagreed with? Hm. Well,
that's fine. But if you change
your mind, please come back
and ask me anytime. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[迪策]
哦？合同中是否有
您不同意的条款？嗯。
没关系。但如果您改变主意，
请随时回来找我。谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Good day, I'm
Liei Kuniziet of the
Employee Mission
Reward Department
here in Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
您好，我是
达纳托斯塔
员工任务奖励部门的
莉埃·库尼齐特。

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Ah, hello~
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
啊，你好~
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Employee's mission reward?
scripts.translation: 员工任务奖励？

scripts.text: Keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 继续加油。

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Currently, Rekenber Corporation
is contracting temp employees
to develop the higher levels
of Thanatos Tower. If you'd
like to apply, please ask
Ditze right next to me.
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
目前，雷肯贝尔公司
正在招募临时员工
开发达纳托斯塔的高层。
如果您想申请，请询问
我旁边的迪策。

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Thank you. Ah, and I hope
that you enjoy your visit
here to Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
谢谢。啊，希望您
在达纳托斯塔的访问愉快。

scripts.text:
Ah, hello~
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
啊，你好~
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Reward
scripts.translation: 奖励

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Alright, then.
Please do your best
to exterminate the
monsters that infest
the higher floors of
the Thanatos Tower~
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
好的。
请尽力清剿
达纳托斯塔高层
滋生的魔物~

scripts.text:
[Liei]
You're {0}, yes?
Let me check our temp
employee records for--ah.
Here it is. Alright, so would
you please tell me what kind
of mission proof you brought?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
您是{0}，对吧？
让我查一下我们的临时
员工记录——啊。
在这里。好的，那么请告诉我
您带来了哪种任务证明？

scripts.text: Golden Ornament
scripts.translation: 金色手镯

scripts.text: Red Feather
scripts.translation: 红色羽毛

scripts.text: Blue Feather
scripts.translation: 蓝色羽毛

scripts.text: Cursed Seal
scripts.translation: 被诅咒的印

scripts.text:
[Liei]
I'm sorry, but you are not
carrying any {0}.
Please check your inventory
one more time, and then come
to me to redeem your items
for a reward later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
很抱歉，您身上并没有携带{0}。
请再次检查您的物品栏，
之后再来找我兑换奖励，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Liei]
The reward for each
{0} is...
 
1,000 zeny
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
每个{0}的奖励是...

1,000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Liei]
{0}, then
you will receive a total of...
 
{1} zeny
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
那么，{0}
您总共将获得...

{1} Zeny

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Would you like to exchange
all of your {0}
for your reward right now?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Great! Here is your
{0} zeny. Thank you,
and please keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
太好了！这是您的
{0} Zeny。谢谢，
请继续努力工作~

scripts.text:
[Liei]
Sure, no problem.
Just come back and
talk to me whenever
you want to receive
your reward, alright?
scripts.translation:
[莉埃]
当然，没问题。
想领取奖励的时候
随时回来找我对话就好，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
You are in front of the entrance to the 3rd Floor. Only contracted
temp employees are authorized
to enter that area. For Rekenber temp contract information, please
speak to the 2nd Floor Guide.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
您正站在3楼的入口处。只有签订了
合同的临时员工才有权限进入该区域。如需了解雷肯贝尔的临时合同信息，请
与2楼的向导对话。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
This is the path to the 3rd floor.
Only the contracted staff are allowed to enter.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
这是通往3楼的通道。
只有签约的职员才能进入。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Let me go to 3rd floor.
scripts.translation: 让我去3楼

scripts.text: Tower Information.
scripts.translation: 中央塔资讯

scripts.text: Start a conversation.
scripts.translation: 开始对话

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Oh, alright. Let me
check and see if you're
on our temp list. Hmmm...
Ah, you're {0}, right?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
哦，好的。让我
查一下您是否在
我们的临时员工名单上。嗯...
啊，您是{0}，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
First, we need to wait until
at least 5 temps are gathered
to form a work group. Right
now, there are a total of
{0} temp workers waiting to
enter the 3rd Floor.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
首先，我们需要等待
至少5名临时员工聚集
以组成工作小组。目前，共有
{0}名临时工人在等待
进入3楼。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Great, you're just
in time. We just met
the minimum 5 temp group
requirement, so we'll open
the gate to the 3rd Floor soon.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
太好了，您来得
正是时候。我们刚刚达到
5人临时小组的最低要求，
所以我们将很快打开
通往3楼的大门。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
If you can, try to get
your friends to help you
by coming near me. Please
understand that we have this
temp worker group requirement
for various safety reasons.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
如果可以的话，请让您的
朋友过来协助您，
靠近我这边。请理解我们
有这项临时工人小组要求
是出于各种安全原因。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The gate to the 3rd Floor
will close shortly, so enter it
as soon as you can. We have
to close it quickly because we
can't have the tower monsters
entering the lower floors...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
通往3楼的大门
即将关闭，请尽快进入。
我们必须迅速关闭它，因为
我们不能让塔里的魔物
进入低层...

scripts.text:
^4d4dffBurled is smiling lightly so that only I notice.
I nod, then watch him open the gate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff伯尔德微微一笑，只有我察觉到了。
我点了点头，看着他打开了大门。^000000

scripts.text:
[Burled]
This gate is the only passage
that connects to the 3rd Floor.
After the 4th Floor, passages
between floors only travel one
way, meaning you can't exit the
same way you that you entered.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
这扇门是通往3楼的唯一通道。
从4楼开始，楼层间的通道都是单向的，
也就是说，您无法从进入的通道原路返回。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
You see, there's a strange
power that affects the 5th
Floor, and all floors above,
which doesn't allow people to
backtrack through the passage in which they entered the floor.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
您看，5楼及以上的所有楼层都受到一种神秘力量的影响，
这种力量不允许人们通过进入该楼层的通道原路返回。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
So if you ascend past the
4th Floor, please be careful
and make sure that you find
a way to get back.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
所以，如果您要登上4楼以上，请务必小心，
并确保找到返回的方法。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The top is the 12th floor,
and the monsters grow more powerful
as you ascend the tower.
The geographical features also change considerably.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
塔顶是12楼，
随着楼层升高，魔物会变得更加强大。
地形特征也会发生显著变化。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Because the higher levels are
too dangerous, we only open the
3rd Floor Gate when 5 or more
are gathered here. Therefore,
you may need to wait if less
than 5 temps have gathered.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
由于高层过于危险，
我们只会在聚集了5名或以上临时工时才打开3楼的大门。
因此，如果临时工不足5人，您可能需要等待。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...?
Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...？
您有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: About the development.
scripts.translation: 关于开发情况

scripts.text: The relationship of Cool Event Corporation and Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation: 酷事件公司与雷肯贝尔公司的关系

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
请多保重。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...um, you're quite curious.
If you want to know more, would you do me a favor?
Since you asked for our confidential info...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...嗯，您挺好奇的。
如果您想了解更多，能帮我个忙吗？
既然您问了我们的机密信息...

scripts.text: Really? Don't make me afraid of it.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？别让我害怕。

scripts.text: Just tell me about it.
scripts.translation: 直接告诉我吧。

scripts.text: I'll listen about it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再听。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
As you wish...
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
如你所愿...
请多保重！

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Haha. That's not a big deal.
We, Cool Event, are the corporation that works in many areas of business.
From simple events, guides for dungeons, and trading items.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
哈哈，这没什么大不了的。
我们酷事件公司涉足许多商业领域。
从简单的活动、地下城向导到物品交易。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Though our business started as a small one, we've been getting bigger with assistance from the Rekenber Corporation.
They suggested to develop this tower together.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
虽然我们的业务起初规模很小，但在雷肯贝尔公司的帮助下，我们不断发展壮大。
他们建议共同开发这座塔。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The Rekenber Corporation is only digging out the remains for studies.
The rest would be made into sightseeing place, which Cool Event Corporation can manage well.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
雷肯贝尔公司只负责挖掘遗迹进行研究。
其余部分将改造成观光景点，这正适合酷事件公司来管理。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
It's the biggest business ever.
Also quite profitable as tourist attractions.
But...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
这是有史以来最大的业务。
作为旅游景点也相当有利可图。
但是...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Considerably strong monsters spawn inside the tower.
The monsters weren't spawned there before.
The day after that happened...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
塔内会生成相当强大的魔物。
这些魔物之前并不存在。
就在那件事发生后的第二天...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...anyway, there were some accidently spawned monsters and some troubles...
We and the Rekenber Corporation are in shock.
We were influenced economically, but the more serious thing is...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...总之，发生了一些意外，生成了魔物，还惹出了不少麻烦...
我们和雷肯贝尔公司都受到了冲击。
虽然经济上受到了影响，但更严重的是...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Many staff involved in development are
sacrificing themselves by coming to 3rd floor.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
许多参与开发的职员
为了探索第三层而牺牲了自己。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
While we've pumped our all into the business, that accident happened...
We eventually merged with the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
我们原本全心投入这项业务，却发生了那场意外...
最终，我们不得不与雷肯贝尔公司合并。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The development is on hold temporarily.
Recruiting adventurers to defeat monsters...
Isn't this funny?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
开发工作暂时搁置了。
招募冒险者去消灭魔物...
这难道不滑稽吗？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
No matter what happened there, they wouldn't be hurt.
Even if they don't get at the root of the accident....
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
无论那里发生了什么，他们都不会受伤。
即使他们无法查明事故的根源...

scripts.text: Oh...
What accident are you referring to?
scripts.translation: 你指的是什么事故？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Yes, it's not that big of a deal. Haha....
If we are working here like this....
we would know about the death of animals.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
是的，没什么大不了的。哈哈....
既然我们在这里工作....
对于动物的死亡，我们也是有所了解的。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Cool Event Corporation is considered the follower...
They don't clear up how many people
died or any reasons for it.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
酷事件公司被视为信徒...
他们并没有澄清有多少人
死亡，也没有说明原因。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Now you're curious about this case.
What do they sacrifice for?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
现在你对这个案子感到好奇了。
他们是为了什么而牺牲？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I talked a lot.
Sorry, I am not supposed to talk about this case like this...
I've been quite concerned about it, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
我说了太多。
抱歉，我不应该这样谈论这个案子...
我只是对此相当担忧而已。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
If you promise me that
you will do me a favor...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
如果你答应我
会帮我一个忙...

scripts.text: Ok! I will.
scripts.translation: 好的！我会的。

scripts.text: No, I won't.
scripts.translation: 不，我不会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's the accident...?
He might let me know later...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(那场事故是什么...?
他之后可能会告诉我...)

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...there is no way...
They request you to explore the internal part.
You're employed for this exploration.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...没有别的办法了...
他们要求你探索内部。
你被雇佣来进行这次探索。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Rekenber Corporation must have another intention,
since they don't seem interested in the tower much.
I want to know their intention.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
雷肯贝尔公司一定另有意图，
因为他们似乎对这座塔并不太感兴趣。
我想知道他们的意图。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
This tower is sealed and separated from the outside.
We need to break those seals, explore inside and develop it.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
这座塔被封印，与外界隔绝。
我们需要打破那些封印，探索内部并进行开发。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
We are developing the 3rd and 4th floors now...
There are still seals there.
You can find out some clues when you search around them.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
我们正在开发第三层和第四层...
那里仍然有封印。
当你在那里搜索时，可能会发现一些线索。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The magical key and messages?
...we absolutely haven't learned all the tower's secrets...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
魔法钥匙和信息？
...我们绝对还没有掌握这座塔的所有秘密...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Who made the seals?
...can you investigate more?
There must be definitive evidence...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
是谁设下的封印？
...你能再深入调查一下吗？
一定会有确凿的证据...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Any new progress?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
有什么新的进展吗？

scripts.text: I found Varmunt's Journal...
scripts.translation: 我找到了瓦尔蒙特的日记...

scripts.text:
- You show him Varmunt's Journal.
Burled reads it. -
scripts.translation:
- 你向伯尔德展示了瓦尔蒙特的日记。
伯尔德读了起来。 -

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...I recognize this.
This is the hologragh of the wise man Varmunt.
Regenschirm from Rekenber's huge research institute has...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...我认得这个。
这是智者瓦尔蒙特的全息影像。
雷根修芦来自雷肯贝尔巨大的研究所...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...isn't this the one they are looking for now?!
Isn't their mission to find out Varmunt's research materials...?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...这不正是他们现在在寻找的东西吗？！
他们的任务不就是找出瓦尔蒙特的研究资料吗...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
For assisting uncompleted research...
Varmunt's research materials are needed...
...so their mission isn't just an investigation of the tower.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
为了协助未完成的研究...
需要瓦尔蒙特的研究资料...
...所以他们的任务不仅仅是调查这座塔。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Something to get as an advantage...
Even they don't know where it is...
...anyways, this is the one of their main objects.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
那是他们想要获取的优势...
即使他们自己也不知道它在哪里...
...总之，这是他们的主要目标之一。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
It's absolutely great. The wise man Varmunt's belongings. How unbelievable!
Now, what do we do with this?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
这太棒了。智者瓦尔蒙特的遗物。简直难以置信！
现在，我们要怎么处理这个？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Originally everything we found out in this tower was under control of the Rekenber Corporation.
This is supposed to theirs, but...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
原本我们在这座塔里发现的一切，都受雷肯贝尔公司控制。
按理说这应该属于他们，但是...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
How would you like to keep this, {0}?
Definitely this should be a secret.
...um, this is a little revenge for them.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
你想保留这个吗，{0}？
这绝对应该是个秘密。
...嗯，这算是对他们的一点报复。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I can guess that there are several secrets in this tower through this note.
This secret should be disclosed by you, {0}, before Rekenber does.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
通过这张纸条，我可以推测这座塔里还有好几个秘密。
这个秘密应该由你，{0}，在雷肯贝尔之前揭露出来。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
No matter how much power they obtain... they won't get to know about this tower...
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
无论他们获得多大的权力...他们都不会知道这座塔的事...
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...haha...
I feel a bit relieved.
Thanks.
This isn't much, but here's a return present.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...哈哈...
我感觉轻松了一些。
谢谢。
虽然不多，但这是给你的回礼。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I hope that these will be useful for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
希望这些对你有用，{0}。

scripts.text:
- Burled gives you the note and an Old Violet Box. -
 
^4d4dffYou acquire one Old Violet Box,
as well as a little EXP.^000000
scripts.translation:
- 伯尔德给了你那张纸条和一个旧紫色盒子。 -
 
^4d4dff你获得了1个旧紫色盒子，
以及少量的经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Are you keeping the secrets well?
Is there a Phantom on the top of this tower?
You look tired. This isn't a big deal, but it's for you.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
你守口如瓶吗？
这座塔的顶端有幻影吗？
你看起来很累。虽然不算什么大事，但这是给你的。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Are you keeping the secrets well?
Is there a Phantom on the top of this tower?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
你守口如瓶吗？
这座塔的顶端有幻影吗？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Ah, it's not that difficult.
After you explore the tower, let me know in detail anything you learn.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
啊，没那么难。
探索完塔之后，把你了解到的细节告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
...I can't believe the Rekenber Corporation. Many colleagues and friends died for them.
But the Rekenber Corporation doesn't expose the reason they are dead.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
...我真不敢相信雷肯贝尔公司。许多同事和朋友为他们而死。
但雷肯贝尔公司却不公开他们死亡的原因。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
The conditions were bad for us from beginning...
All of the developed places except research materials would be turned into tourist attractions...
Honestly, all the personnel are from Cool Event Corp.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
从一开始，我们的处境就很糟糕...
除了研究材料，所有开发出来的地方都会变成旅游景点...
说实话，所有的工作人员都来自酷事件公司。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
They know about it as well.
This business needs much sacrifice as well as personnel who are up for it.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
他们对此也心知肚明。
这项业务需要大量的牺牲，也需要愿意为此付出的人员。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
Now I don't feel victimized anymore, but I just want to know what drives these accidents...
^4d4dffWhat makes us victimized...?^000000
That's what I want to know.
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
现在我不再觉得自己是受害者了，但我只是想知道是什么导致了这些事故...
^4d4dff是什么让我们成为了受害者...？^000000
这就是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Burled]
What's this tower?
Why did they develop this dangerous place?
And for what? Should my colleagues be dead for it?
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
这座塔是什么？
他们为什么要开发这个危险的地方？
又是为了什么？难道我的同事们就该为此而死吗？

scripts.text:
[Burled]
I seriously want to know about it.
Why they must sacrifice themselves...
Let me know...
scripts.translation:
[伯尔德]
我真的非常想知道真相。
为什么他们必须牺牲自己...
请告诉我...

scripts.text:
He seriously wants to know about it.
His hands are trembling now...
I nodd without answering.
scripts.translation:
他真的很想知道真相。
他的手现在正在颤抖...
我点了点头，没有回答。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA mysterious field of
energy seems to surround
the mechanical device and
its power prevents you from
approaching the machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一股神秘的力量场
似乎环绕着这个机械装置，
其力量阻止了你
靠近这台机器。^000000

scripts.text: Investigate it.
scripts.translation: 调查一下

scripts.text: I don't care about it.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This seems mysterious...
Let me investigate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这看起来很神秘...
让我调查一下。

scripts.text: ^3355FFAs you follow the magical power, there's something wrapped inside the rune device.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当你跟随那股魔力时，发现符文装置内部包裹着什么东西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou kick the energy
field with all of your strength. After absorbing the impact, the
field fizzles out with a soft,
gentle ''pzzzzzh'' sound.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你用尽全力踢向能量场。在承受住冲击后，
能量场发出一声轻柔的“滋滋”声，
随即消散了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWith your {0} in
hand, you smash the energy
field with all of your strength. After absorbing the impact, the
field fizzles out with a soft,
gentle ''pzzzzzh'' sound.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你手持{0}，
用尽全力砸向能量场。在承受住冲击后，
能量场发出一声轻柔的“滋滋”声，
随即消散了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou smash the energy
field with your weapon
using all of your strength,
but you weren't able to
break down the barrier.
You probably need a more
powerful weapon...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你用武器
拼尽全力砸向能量场，
但没能打破屏障。
你可能需要一把更强大的武器...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
the machine alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定不管这台机器了。^000000

scripts.text: You've acquired everything you need from this rune device.
scripts.translation: 你已经从这个符文装置上获取了所有需要的东西。

scripts.text:
After breaking the device, the exterior shatters.
The energy field begins to disappear,
and you see that a red object inside was the origin of the magical power.
scripts.translation:
打破装置后，外壳碎裂了。
能量场开始消失，
你看到里面有一个红色物体，那是魔力的来源。

scripts.text: - You acquired the powerful Red Key. -
scripts.translation: - 你获得了强大的红色钥匙。 -

scripts.text:
- You acquired the powerful Red Key. -
^4d4dffOnce you hold the key, a shocking feeling passes through your head.
You see an illusion of light...^000000
scripts.translation:
- 你获得了强大的红色钥匙。 -
^4d4dff当你握住钥匙时，一股震惊的感觉传遍你的大脑。
你看到了光的幻觉...^000000

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text: Concentrate on it.
scripts.translation: 集中注意力。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
the machine alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定不管这台机器了。^000000

scripts.text:
You focus on the light.
Some letters begin to appear...
scripts.translation:
你注视着那束光。
一些文字开始浮现...

scripts.text:
^b22222I've used the Gate Seal
technology to seal the gate
and the charm stones. Although
the seals are in place, I can't
stop worrying that they might
break in the future.
scripts.translation: ^b22222我使用了封印技术，将大门和魔力石都封印了起来。虽然封印已经生效，但我仍担心它们未来可能会破裂。

scripts.text:
^b22222I can't relax when a, shall
I say, particular group covets
the charm stones and can easily
break the seals. Since they are
broken now, are many people hurt?
scripts.translation: ^b22222只要一想到有一群特定的人觊觎着魔力石，并且能够轻易破坏封印，我就无法放松。既然封印现在已经破碎了，是不是有很多人因此受伤？

scripts.text:
^b22222This tower contains strong
magical powers and much evil. It is
dangerous by itself, but I sealed it
because of one man's strong desires...
scripts.translation: ^b22222这座塔蕴含着强大的魔力，也充满了邪恶。它本身就十分危险，但我之所以封印它，是因为某个人的强烈欲望...

scripts.text:
^b22222I wouldn't recommend to go futher.
You would need to challenge that poor
being, who I've named this tower after.
His soul still rests here...
scripts.translation:
^b22222我不建议你继续深入。
你需要挑战那个可怜的存在，这座塔就是以他的名字命名的。
他的灵魂至今仍留在这里...

scripts.text:
^b22222Nobody believed me, the crazy scientist.
Though I wanted to keep this a secret, somebody
must get to know about it. That's way I created
this rune device, and hid this message.
scripts.translation:
^b22222没有人相信我，这个疯狂的科学家。
虽然我想保守这个秘密，但总得有人知道真相。所以我制造了这个符文装置，并藏起了这条信息。

scripts.text:
^b22222Please show that my experience
wasn't just an illusion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^b22222请证明我的经历不仅仅是一场幻觉。^000000

scripts.text:
That's all.
The letters fly away in the form of a red key...
scripts.translation:
到此为止。
文字化作红色钥匙的形状飞走了...

a numeric keypad underneath.

number keys, you hear a
beep as the screen activates.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一个屏幕，上面有三个小面板，下方是一个数字键盘。
当你按下其中一个数字键时，屏幕激活并发出哔声。^000000

^4d4dff强大的黄色钥匙出现了。^000000
^4d4dff一股强烈的感觉传遍你的大脑。

Some letters begin to appear...
scripts.translation:
你注视着那束光。
一些文字开始浮现...

scripts.text:
^b22222Have you found the second key?
I wish to tell you where the seal is, but I won't unveil it so easily.
Here's a hint. Go to the eagle on the 5th floor.
scripts.translation:
^b22222你找到第二把钥匙了吗？
我想告诉你封印的位置，但我不会轻易透露。
给你一个提示。去5楼找那只鹰。

scripts.text:
^b22222The reason I came here is...
to find someone.
We human beings can't understand this...
scripts.translation:
^b22222我来到这里的原因是...
为了寻找某个人。
我们人类无法理解这一点...

scripts.text:
^b22222When I found her in Juperos, I couldn't relax.
The giant men staying with her in deep side of cave
made me rush through my investigation...
scripts.translation:
^b22222当我在朱佩罗斯找到她时，我无法放松。
那些住在洞穴深处、陪伴着她的巨人，让我加快了调查的速度...

scripts.text:
^b22222After confirming her existence, I became blindly obsessed with finding traces of her.
'Her', you ask? She is shaped like a woman...
scripts.translation:
^b22222在确认了她的存在后，我变得盲目地执着于寻找她的踪迹。
你问“她”是谁？她的形状像是一个女人...

scripts.text:
^b22222I followed her traces without knowing that she existed 10 years earlier.
Then I came upon this place.
scripts.translation:
^b22222我追寻着她的踪迹，却不知她早在10年前就已存在。
然后，我来到了这个地方。

scripts.text: ^b22222This tower set up for...^000000

scripts.translation: 它突然震动，然后消失了。

scripts.text:
I can feel some magical power from this beautiful stone statue.
There's a little crack between the wings.
scripts.translation:
我能感觉到这座美丽的石像散发着某种魔力。
翅膀之间有一道细小的裂缝。

scripts.text:
Red light is shining on a crack in the left wing, and gold light on a crack in the right one.
What will you do?
scripts.translation:
红光照射在左翼的裂缝上，金光照射在右翼的裂缝上。
你要怎么做？

scripts.text: Stick the key into the crack...
scripts.translation: 将钥匙插入裂缝...

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
the statue alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定不去动这座石像。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll try the left wing first.
What key should I put in?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我先试试左翼。
我该放哪把钥匙？

scripts.text: It doesn't fit into the crack.
scripts.translation: 它插不进裂缝里。

scripts.text:
The key fits and makes a click.
You feel the magical power growing stronger...
scripts.translation:
钥匙插进去了，发出咔哒一声。
你感觉到魔力正在增强...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now the right side...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在轮到右边了...

scripts.text: It doesn't fit into the crack.
scripts.translation: 它插不进裂缝里。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

鸟的喙突然张开，一道强光射出。
里面有一个钥匙形状的东西...

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThe powerful Blue Key appears.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff强大的蓝色钥匙出现了。^000000

^4d4dffThe powerful Blue Key appears.^000000

scripts.translation:

^4d4dff当你握住钥匙时，一股震惊的感觉传遍你的大脑。
你看到了光的幻觉...^000000

scripts.text: Concentrate on it.
scripts.translation: 集中注意力。

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
This part isn't as clear as before.
You try to figure out what it's saying...
scripts.translation:
这部分不如之前清晰。
你试图弄清楚它想说什么...

scripts.text:
^b22222...this tower was built by a magical tribe, not by human beings.
This was quite interesting to me...
I started to investigate why they built up the tower...
scripts.translation:
^b22222...这座塔是由一个魔法部落建造的，而不是人类。
这对我来说非常有趣...
我开始调查他们为什么要建造这座塔...

scripts.text:
^b22222I found out that this tower was a gate for the magic tribe
during a millennium war.^000000
scripts.translation: ^b22222我发现，这座塔是千年战争期间魔法部族的传送门。^000000

scripts.text:
.........It's not clearly shown......
^b22222...Morocc has gone through this gate
from the magical world into the Midgard continent after the millennium war terminated...
scripts.translation:
.........显示得并不清晰......
^b22222...千年战争结束后，莫洛奇通过这座传送门，从魔法世界进入了米德加尔特大陆...

scripts.text:
^b22222The question is that when she come up here, the Satan appears at the same time...
The truth is..........^000000
scripts.translation:
^b22222问题是，当她来到这里时，撒旦也同时出现了...
真相是..........^000000

scripts.text: The illusion shakes, then melts on the surface of the key as light.
scripts.translation: 幻觉摇曳着，随后化作光芒，在钥匙表面消融。

scripts.text: You decide to ignore it.
scripts.translation: 你决定无视它。

scripts.text: You try to fit something in the crack, but to no avail.
scripts.translation: 你试图将某物塞进缝隙中，但无济于事。

scripts.text: You've acquired everything you need from this statue.
scripts.translation: 你已从这座雕像处获得了所有需要的东西。

scripts.text:
I can feel some magical power from this brilliant statue.
This must be one of the seals.
scripts.translation:
我能从这座光辉雕像中感受到一股魔力。
这一定是封印之一。

scripts.text:
You see a floating round object with a hole in it.
There're red, yellow, and blue light in a row.
What will you do?
scripts.translation:
你看到一个悬浮的圆形物体，中间有一个孔。
红、黄、蓝三色光芒依次排列。
你要怎么做？

scripts.text: Investigate.
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't see the need to
investigate if nothing seems
peculiar or out of place...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF既然看起来没有什么特别或不对劲的地方...
似乎没必要深入调查...^000000

scripts.text:
When you insert the key into the keyhole of the ornament
and match them by corresponding color, the Stone Statue will snap open.
You can see small wheels are moving inside.
scripts.translation:
当你将钥匙插入饰品的锁孔，并按对应颜色匹配时，石像会“咔哒”一声弹开。
可以看到内部有小齿轮在转动。

scripts.text: Investigate the Machine Chasis
scripts.translation: 检查机器底盘

scripts.text: Investigate the Wheels
scripts.translation: 检查齿轮

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe key in your inventory
does not seem to be affecting
the machine's chasis. The
screen mounted on the side
is still blank and deactivated.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你背包里的钥匙似乎对机器底盘没有影响。
侧面安装的屏幕仍然是空白的，处于未激活状态。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou touch the wheels and
find that they are actually
moving very slowly. You note
that there are 2 small wheels
and 3 larger wheels, totaling
5 wheels on this machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你触摸齿轮，发现它们实际上正在非常缓慢地转动。
你注意到这台机器上有2个小齿轮和3个大齿轮，总共5个齿轮。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe big wheels are moving
vertically, up and down, as
they press against the smaller
wheels to make them rotate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大齿轮在垂直方向上下移动，
它们压在小齿轮上，使其旋转。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJudging from the machine's
shaking and jittery noises, the
wheels may be misaligned.
You might be able to activate
the machine by properly 
aligning all the wheels.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF从机器的震动和咔哒声判断，齿轮可能错位了。
如果你能正确对齐所有齿轮，也许就能激活这台机器。^000000

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
As you adjust the wheels,
they suddenly activate
with a firm click.
scripts.translation:
当你调整齿轮时，
它们突然发出清脆的咔哒声，
开始转动起来。

scripts.text:
A part of the ornament in the stone statue starts to spin,
and a shining light beam climbs up the elegant statue.
A strong cursed power emerges and emits a dazzling green light.
scripts.translation:
石像上的装饰部件开始旋转，
一道耀眼的光束沿着优雅的石像向上攀升。
一股强大的诅咒之力涌现，
散发出耀眼的绿光。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffAll of a sudden, the Green Key appears and you can feel great power from it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff突然，绿色钥匙出现了，你能感受到其中蕴含的强大力量。^000000

scripts.text:
^4d4dffAll of a sudden, the Green Key appears and you can feel great power from it.^000000
^4d4dffWhen you pick up the key,
your body trembles
with an unknown power
and you see a hallucination with some text.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff突然，绿色钥匙出现了，你能感受到其中蕴含的强大力量。^000000
^4d4dff当你拿起钥匙时，
你的身体因一股未知的力量而颤抖，
你看到了带有文字的幻象。^000000

scripts.text: Concentrate on it.
scripts.translation: 集中注意力。

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
^b22222...You found 4 keys
and finally released 4 spells...
This tower used to be
a gate to summon demons ages ago.
And the last visitor was
the infamous Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
^b22222...你找到了4把钥匙，
并终于释放了4个咒语...
这座塔曾经是
召唤恶魔的传送门。
而最后的访客是
臭名昭著的魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text:
^b22222As I followed her trail
I realized that her spells
were scattered around the tower.
Then, somehow, it vanished into the ground.
scripts.translation:
^b22222当我追踪她的踪迹时，
我发现她的咒语散落在塔中各处。
然后，不知为何，它消失在了地面之下。

scripts.text:
^b22222The great battle and
the protracted war...
But her purpose was...
that... sealing of the gate...
so... I tried to seal...
but it was incomplete...
the guard of the gate was...^000000
scripts.translation:
^b22222那场伟大的战斗
和漫长的战争...
但她的目的是...
那个...封印传送门...
所以...我试图封印...
但它并不完整...
传送门的守卫是...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is hard to read.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
字迹难以辨认。

scripts.text:
^b22222...So I changed the location
of the coupling spot...
I mean, push through to the tower
to tangle it...
Anyway, I wanted to respect
her loyalty and block the gate...
scripts.translation:
^b22222...于是我改变了连接点的位置...
我的意思是，强行突破到塔中
将其纠缠在一起...
总之，我想尊重她的忠诚，
并封锁传送门...

scripts.text:
^b22222If I want to... then I have to
release the last spell...
He finally came to meet...
with his pieces...
...and then...^000000
scripts.translation:
^b22222如果我想...那么我就必须
释放最后一个咒语...
他终于带着他的棋子
前来赴约了...
...然后...^000000

scripts.text:
The hallucination wobbles
and fades into the key.
scripts.translation: 幻觉摇曳不定，最终化作了钥匙。

scripts.text: It was too intense to see the hallucination, so you gave up reading.
scripts.translation: 幻觉太过强烈，你无法看清，于是放弃了阅读。

scripts.text: You decide to ignore it.
scripts.translation: 你决定无视它。

scripts.text: You don't have the right key for this keyhole.
scripts.translation: 你没有适合这个锁孔的钥匙。

scripts.text: The spell is already released. You've acquired everything you need from this statue.
scripts.translation: 咒语已经释放。你已从这尊雕像处获得所需的一切。

scripts.text:
An old, worn sword hangs above the splendid table.
It emits a gloomy aura.
scripts.translation:
一把古老、磨损的剑悬挂在华丽的桌子上方。
它散发着阴森的气息。

scripts.text:
As you approach, the keys in your pocket
suddenly respond with a mysterious power.
scripts.translation:
当你靠近时，口袋里的钥匙
突然响应着一种神秘的力量。

scripts.text: Observe it.
scripts.translation: 观察它

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
the sword alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定不去碰那把剑。^000000

scripts.text:
While you get closer and closer, the sword shakes with a loud noise.
Your eyes keep getting drawn to the sword's hilt.
Then you lose control of your hands, and they stretch forth to grasp the handle...
scripts.translation:
随着你越来越近，剑发出巨大的声响并剧烈震动。
你的目光不由自主地被剑柄吸引。
接着你失去了对手的控制，双手不由自主地伸出去握住剑柄...

scripts.text: Towards the blade of the sword
scripts.translation: 伸向剑刃

scripts.text: Towards the hilt of the sword
scripts.translation: 伸向剑柄

scripts.text: Towards the table
scripts.translation: 伸向桌子

scripts.text:
By an unknown calling you decide to grab the blade of the sword.
Your hands get wounded and begin to bleed.
scripts.translation:
在某种未知的召唤下，你决定抓住剑刃。
你的手受伤了，开始流血。

scripts.text:
By an unknown calling you decide to grab the hilt of the sword.
The mysterious power from the keys transfers to the sword, and it falls from the table.
scripts.translation:
在某种未知的召唤下，你决定握住剑柄。
钥匙中的神秘力量转移到了剑上，剑从桌上掉落。

scripts.text:
At the same time, a little hole appears on the table's surface.
Now, you hold the sword and...
scripts.translation:
与此同时，桌面上出现了一个小孔。
现在，你握着剑，并且...

scripts.text: Strike the table
scripts.translation: 敲击桌子

scripts.text: Insert the sword into the hole
scripts.translation: 将剑插入孔中

scripts.text: Bring the sword safely
scripts.translation: 安全地带走剑

scripts.text:
You strike the table with the sword.
Numerous conflicting spells act upon it, and you can tell that you chose incorrectly.
The sword automatically returns to the table, as it was before.
scripts.translation:
你用剑敲击了桌子。
无数相互冲突的魔法作用于其上，你意识到自己选错了。
剑自动回到了桌上，恢复了原状。

scripts.text:
As you insert the sword, lightning flashes around it and black smoke rises from the hole.
Slowly the smoke clears, and you see an object with a certain shape...
scripts.translation:
当你将剑插入孔中时，周围闪过雷电，孔中升起黑烟。
烟雾渐渐散去，你看到一个具有特定形状的物品...

scripts.text: ^4d4dff All of a sudden, a Black Key appears from the smoke and you feel a great cursed power from it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff突然，一把黑色钥匙从烟雾中显现，你从中感受到一股强大的诅咒之力。^000000

scripts.text:
A drawer had snapped open under the table while you picked up the key and observed it.
You can see an old notebook inside the drawer.
scripts.translation:
当你拿起钥匙并观察它时，桌子下方的一个抽屉突然弹开了。
你可以看到抽屉里有一本旧笔记本。

scripts.text:
The notebook definitely looks like it contains an important message.
Maybe this notebook is the one that Rekenber wants to find, even with all the sacrifices.
scripts.translation:
这本笔记本看起来确实包含重要信息。
也许这就是雷肯贝尔不惜一切代价也要寻找的那本笔记本。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou decide to show the notebook and the keys to Burled.
You received Varmunt's Journal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff你决定将笔记本和钥匙展示给伯尔德。
你获得了瓦尔蒙特的日记。^000000

scripts.text:
When you lift the sword, you feel a shock from numerous conflicting spells.
Right... stealing is the worst.
The sword automatically returns to the table, as it was before.
scripts.translation:
当你举起剑时，你感受到无数相互冲突的魔法带来的冲击。
没错...偷窃是最糟糕的行为。
剑自动回到了桌上，恢复了原状。

scripts.text: You stretch your hands to find something under the table, but there is nothing.
scripts.translation: 你伸手去摸桌子下面，想找到什么东西，但那里什么都没有。

scripts.text:
You strongly feel a cursed, sealed power from here,
but it is hard to figure out what is causing it.
You cannot approach it.
scripts.translation:

但很难弄清楚是什么造成的。
你无法靠近它。

scripts.text:
You have already released a seal using this sword.
You've acquired everything you need from here.
scripts.translation:
你已经用这把剑解开了一个封印。
你在这里已经获得了所有需要的东西。

scripts.text: The Crystal ball is emitting mysterious power.
scripts.translation: 水晶球正散发着神秘的力量。

scripts.text:
Beside the crystal ball, you find faded patterns marked on the floor.
Looks like some kind of keyhole that needs to be inserted with something...
scripts.translation:
在水晶球旁边，你发现地板上刻有褪色的图案。
看起来像是某种需要插入某物的钥匙孔...

scripts.text:
The red key suddenly responds once you come close to the keyhole.
You insert the key in the keyhole and it turns out to be a small gem.
scripts.translation:
当你靠近钥匙孔时，红色钥匙突然有了反应。
你将钥匙插入钥匙孔，结果发现它其实是一颗小宝石。

scripts.text:
When you touch the gem which is dazzling red...
You feel isolated and depressed deep inside your heart...
scripts.translation:
当你触摸那颗耀眼的红色宝石时...
你内心深处感到一种孤立无援和深深的压抑...

scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你找到了一颗魔力红宝石，其中凝聚着残酷的命运和深沉的黑暗。^000000
